# Node.js service — golden-path scaffold generated by Makeway

## Layout

```
.
├── server.js             # Express app — exposes / and /health
├── package.json
├── setup.sh              # golden-path setup (npm install + smoke check)
├── Dockerfile            # node:20-alpine, port 3000
└── .github/workflows/    # CI runs on merge to main (placed at repo root)
```

## Run locally

```bash
./setup.sh
npm start
```

## Health

`GET /health` → `{"status": "healthy"}`
